column1: # journal-archive-three-dates.tsv — three rows whose OWN timestamps fall on three
# different UTC dates, for do_archive's date partitioning.
# The offsets are EXACTLY 86400 apart, which is the whole design of this fixture.
# "now-1s / now-1d / now-2d" would collide: run one second after midnight, now-1s and
# now-86400s land on the SAME date and the case would silently degrade to two files
# while still looking green. Whole days from one PNOW cannot collide, whatever second
# What it separates: filing by the ROW's own date from filing by "today". A reading
# that used today's date would put all three rows in one file and every other
